title: HolonLevelRelation
description: A discovered relation between two candidate entities (docs/holon-level.md). Never assigned: 'above' requires both existence-dependency (the subject cannot exist without the candidate) and possibility-constraint (the candidate narrows the subject's possibility space) to clear their own Born-null thresholds. 'peer' means neither holds -- polycentric, no level exists. 'unstable' means they disagree -- a typed gap, never silently resolved into a level.

relation.description: 'above' = candidate is above subject (both gates passed). 'peer' = polycentric, no level (neither gate passed). 'unstable' = gates disagree, a typed gap.

subject_id.description: Audit label only. The actual direction is determined by which entity's degradation/narrowing was measured to produce `existence`/`constraint`, not by this field.

candidate_id.description: Audit label only, paired with subject_id.

existence.description: Result of existenceDependencyTest: does the subject depend on the candidate ('cannot exist without')?

constraint.description: Result of possibilityConstraintTest: does the candidate constrain the subject ('above constrains, below enables')?

reason.description: Why this relation was discovered -- which gates agreed or disagreed.
